items.source: Subclasses must implement the getTarget() and releaseTarget(Object) methods based on their chosen object pool. The AbstractPrototypeBasedTargetSource.newPrototypeInstance() method inherited from AbstractPrototypeBasedTargetSource can be used to create objects in order to put them into the pool.
items.translation: 子类必须根据其选择的对象池实现 getTarget() 和 releaseTarget(Object) 方法。继承自 AbstractPrototypeBasedTargetSource 的 AbstractPrototypeBasedTargetSource.newPrototypeInstance() 方法可用于创建对象，以便将它们放入池中。

items.source: Subclasses must also implement some monitoring methods from the PoolingConfig interface. The getPoolingConfigMixin() method makes these stats available on proxied objects through an IntroductionAdvisor.
items.translation: 子类还必须实现来自PoolingConfig接口的某些监控方法。getPoolingConfigMixin()方法通过 IntroductionAdvisor 将这些统计信息提供给代理对象。

items.source: This class implements the DisposableBean interface in order to force subclasses to implement a DisposableBean.destroy() method, closing down their object pool.
items.translation: 该类实现了DisposableBean接口，以强制子类实现DisposableBean.destroy()方法，从而关闭其对象池。
